allow: PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in @\(3000, 3001, 5000, 8080, 4000\) } | ForEach-Object { Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } | Select-Object Id, Name, MainWindowTitle | Sort-Object -Unique Id)
PowerShell(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "node" } | Select-Object Id, Name, CPU, StartTime)
PowerShell(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "node|electron|serve|vite|http-server|express" } | Select-Object Id, Name, CPU)
PowerShell(Get-Process | Select-Object Id, Name, @{N='Path';E={try{$_.MainModule.FileName}catch{''}}} | Where-Object { $_.Path -match "Mirocard|node" } | Select-Object Id, Name, Path)
